snippet.title: Celestial Return - Steam Next Fest Announcement
snippet.description:
Celestial Return is a story-driven RPG where dice are your bullets, your bribes, and your last breath. Loot, gamble, and survive a reality-crumbling city. Uncover cosmic horrors, outwit corrupted megacorps, and pray your next roll isn't your last.

PLAY THE DEMO:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2704090/Celestial_Return/

LATE PLEDGES AVAILABLE ON KICKSTARTER: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/metaphorgames/celestial-return-sci-fi-noir-rpg

WEBSITE: https://www.celestialreturn.com/
X.com: https://x.com/MetaphorGames
Celestial Return Discord Channel: https://discord.gg/NPPs8SNgvw
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/metaphorgames_/
YOUTUBE: https://www.youtube.com/@MetaphorGames/videos 
LINKEDIN: https://www.linkedin.com/company/metaphor-games
